mods.name: SULFUR Multiplayer
mods.summary: Online co-op for 2–8 players. Fight the same enemies, share the loot and drop into each other's levels through Steam.
mods.description:
SULFUR Multiplayer lets you and your friends play SULFUR together. One player loads their save and hosts from the F8 menu, and everyone else joins through Steam (an invite, or "Join Game" in the friends list) — no IP addresses or port forwarding. Joiners drop straight into the host's level and follow them from level to level, and the whole party always lands in the same world. Enemies are run by the host's game, go after every player and scale with the number of players. Boss fights, thrown grenades, loot, chests, doors, breakables and loose physics objects are shared, the church stash and shops are shared, and you can hand ammo to a teammate with one key. Other players show up as goblins holding whatever weapon they have out. Everyone keeps their own character, inventory and save.

The zip contains an installer (SulfurMP-Setup.exe) that finds your SULFUR folder and sets everything up, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Everyone needs the same version.
details: 2–8 players, joined through Steam invites or "Join Game" (no port forwarding)
Enemy count scales with players (2 players = 2x enemies)
Shared enemies, boss fights, grenades, loot, chests, doors and physics objects
Shared church stash and shops, and give ammo to teammates with G
Friends follow the host automatically and always end up in the same world
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 0.4.0: enemies scale with player count (2 players = 2x enemies), shared boss fights, synced hold-to-open doors and metal gates, thrown grenades show for everyone, shared church stash and shops, give ammo to a teammate with G, everyone always lands in the same world when someone takes an exit, and taller goblins with properly placed arms. Everyone must update — 0.3.0 can't play with 0.4.0.

mods.name: Noita Multiplayer
mods.summary: Two-player online co-op in one shared, fully synced Noita world. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
Noita Multiplayer puts you and a friend in the same world at the same time: terrain, liquids, fire, enemies, items, physics objects, spells, perks, orbs and hearts are all synced. Pick "Co-op: Host" or "Co-op: Join" in the New Game menu, or invite your friend through Steam and their game loads your world by itself — even if they're sitting on the main menu. If you die while your partner is alive (even as a polymorphed creature) you go down instead, and they can revive you.

The zip contains an installer (NoitaCoop_Installer.exe) that sets everything up, the raw mod folders if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Both players need the same version.
details: Shared world: terrain, water, fire, enemies, items and physics props stay in sync
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding), even from the main menu, or by direct IP
Downed & revive (polymorphed too), shared perks, orbs and hearts
Installer exe + raw mod folders + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 1.4.0: invited friends can join from Noita's main menu (host uses F9 > Invite <friend>, the friend just starts a game), dying while polymorphed now puts you down instead of ending the run, and doubled enemies/objects are detected and merged automatically. Both players must update (1.3.0 can't connect to 1.4.0).

mods.name: FTL: Faster Than Light Multiplayer
mods.summary: Crew one ship together—online co-op for up to 8 players, each controlling one crew member. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
FTL Co-op puts up to 8 players on the same ship. Each player controls one crew member and runs the controls of the room they're standing in: the pilot handles power, jumps and the star map, the gunner aims and fires, and the doors, drones, teleporter, cloaking, hacking and mind control each belong to whoever mans that room. Crew nobody controls are run by a smarter AI that mans stations, repairs, fights fires and boarders and heads to the medbay when hurt. Invite a Steam friend from FTL's main menu (no port forwarding), or join by IP.

The zip contains an installer (FTL-Coop-Install.exe) that rolls FTL back to 1.6.9 and sets everything up, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Everyone needs the same version.
details: Up to 8 players share one ship, one crew member each
Room-based controls: piloting, weapons, drones, doors and more
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding) or by direct IP
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 11.0.0: first public build (co-op mod version 11). Up to 8 players, Steam invites or IP, join or leave mid-run, vote to save and quit, smarter AI crew for unclaimed crew members. Needs FTL 1.6.9 - the installer rolls it back for you.
